questions.question: He said, 'I'm going to the party tonight.' What did he say?
options: I'm going to the party tomorrow.
He's going to the party tonight.
That he is going to the party tonight.
Tonight he's going to the party.
questions.answer: That he is going to the party tonight.

questions.question: The new policy has been widely accepted by the public since it was introduced last year.
options: It is expected that the policy will be widely accepted.
The policy was not well-received initially.
The public were unhappy with the introduction of the policy.
The company has decided to review the policy.
questions.answer: The new policy has been widely accepted by the public since it was introduced last year.

questions.question: I would pass the exam if I had studied harder.
options: I would have been better off not studying.
Studying hard is pointless.
It's too late now to change anything.
I'm glad I didn't study as much.
questions.answer: I would have passed the exam if I had studied harder.

questions.question: The manager found the team's performance unacceptable and very disappointing.
options: The manager thought the team did a great job.
He praised their effort but criticized their results.
Their performance was not up to standard.
They were lucky to get away with such poor play.
questions.answer: Their performance was not up to standard.

questions.question: The company needs someone who can work on their own and take responsibility for their actions.
options: They want someone who is a team player.
Someone with experience in management would be ideal.
A person who is very organized and efficient would suit the job best.
They are looking for someone with excellent communication skills.
questions.answer: A person who is very organized and efficient would suit the job best.

questions.question: The new restaurant has a good ambiance, although it's quite pricey.
options: It's a great place to eat out, but the prices are steep.
I wouldn't recommend it for special occasions.
The food is excellent, but the service is slow.
It's not worth going there due to its high costs.

questions.question: The government is planning to increase taxes on petrol as a way of reducing pollution.
options: They are considering introducing a new tax on diesel.
The aim is to make public transport more affordable.
The goal is to encourage people to use bicycles instead of cars.
The focus is on making fuel more expensive.
questions.answer: The government is planning to increase taxes on petrol as a way of reducing pollution.

questions.question: The teacher told the students that they should write their essays with a blue pen.
options: They were advised to use a red pen.
She said they could use any colour of pen they liked.
He recommended using a black pen for clarity.
It was specified that they must use a green pen.
questions.answer: The teacher told the students that they should write their essays with a blue pen.

questions.question: The tourists were confused about which direction to go to get to the hotel.
options: They asked for directions from a local, who gave them good advice.
They had a map of the area but couldn't read it.
They decided to take a taxi instead of walking.
They followed their instincts and eventually found the hotel.
questions.answer: The tourists were confused about which direction to go to get to the hotel.

questions.question: Despite the recession, the company has seen a significant rise in its earnings.
options: Their losses were much greater than expected.
They had to lay off many employees due to financial difficulties.
Their sales have decreased sharply.
The company's growth was mainly due to external factors.
questions.answer: Despite the recession, the company has seen a significant rise in its earnings.
